name: Undercover Speed Dating (with Wolves)
source: Undercover Speed Dating (with Wolves) is a game where you flirt your way behind wolf-enemy lines. Your mission? To infiltrate wolf speed dating, pee on some fire hydrants and rescue the human they've got trapped in the kitchen.
